intro.title: DRAWN FROM THE DARK
paragraphs: INKTENEBRIS is a collection of surreal ballpoint pen illustrations exploring psychological horror, distorted identity, dream imagery and isolation.
Every artwork is created entirely by hand through dense layers of ink and obsessive mark-making.

showcases.description: Psychological ballpoint illustration exploring observation, isolation and distorted identity.
A study of emptiness and perception rendered entirely with ballpoint pen.

selected.title: SELECTED WORKS
selected.description: A collection of surreal ballpoint pen drawings exploring identity, fear, isolation and transformation.

manifesto.title: ART IS NOT MEANT TO COMFORT.
manifesto.text: It is meant to disturb, question and linger. Every drawing is an attempt to visualize thoughts that usually remain hidden.
